fml.menu.mods.info.description.xiaojingy: Xiao Jing Yu's Home: the Minecraft mod of the Seaside Cottage.
xiaojingyu.configuration.title: Xiao Jing Yu's Home settings
xiaojingyu.configuration.section.xiaojin: Xiao Jing Yu's Home: capture range
xiaojingyu.configuration.captureFront.to: How far the plain /xjy capture reaches in front of you, starting with the block in front.
xiaojingyu.configuration.captureBack.too: Also take what is behind you: this many blocks back, starting with the one you stand on. 0 = nothing behind. /xjy capture with three numbers uses it too.
xiaojingyu.configuration.captureSide.too: How many blocks to the left and to the right (both the same); width = 2 × this + 1.
xiaojingyu.configuration.captureUp.toolt: How many layers, starting with the floor under your feet.
xiaojingyu.configuration.blacklist.toolt: Blocks that capture writes as air, the same list /xjy blacklist opens. One list for the whole game.
xiaojingyu.configuration.blacklist.not_i: Only in a world (single player needs cheats on).
xiaojingyu.configuration.blacklist.no_mo: This server does not have Xiao Jing Yu's Home.
xiaojingyu.configuration.blacklist.no_pe: Needs the permission to use cheats (level 2).
xiaojingyu.configuration.on_server.label: On a server
xiaojingyu.configuration.on_server.toolt: The server uses the range in its own config/xiaojingyu-common.toml (type /xjy status to see it); ask the server owner to change that file. What you change here is only for your own single-player games.
xiaojingyu.command.capture.done: Captured %1$s×%2$s×%3$s (W×H×L): %4$s blocks that are not air, %5$s block entities. Saved as %6$s
xiaojingyu.command.capture.send_hint: When you send it to someone, send the original image or send it as a file: chat apps compress pictures and lose the data.
xiaojingyu.command.capture.copy_path: Click to copy the full path
xiaojingyu.command.capture.filtered: Saved as air: %1$s blocks on the capture blacklist and %2$s blocks of liquid (water, lava, bubble columns). %3$s waterlogged blocks were saved without the water.
xiaojingyu.command.capture_last.done: Captured the area of your last placement of %1$s (placed standing at %2$s, turned %3$s°, now turned back): same size and layout as that file, so the two compare cell by cell.
xiaojingyu.command.capture_last.none: You have not placed a building with /xjy place in this world yet, so there is no "last" area. Place one first, change it, then use /xjy capture last.
xiaojingyu.command.capture_last.no_level: The dimension of your last placement is not available: %1$s
xiaojingyu.command.capture_last.not_load: Where you last placed %1$s (placed standing at %2$s) is too far away: part of it is not loaded. Move closer and try again.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.added: Added %1$s (%2$s) to the capture blacklist: /xjy capture will save it as air. The list now has %3$s blocks.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.already: %1$s (%2$s) is already on the list. Nothing changed.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.removed: Removed %1$s (%2$s) from the capture blacklist. %3$s blocks are left on the list.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.not_listed: %1$s is not on the list. Nothing changed.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.cleared: Cleared the capture blacklist (%1$s blocks removed).
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.cleared_emp: The capture blacklist was already empty.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.bad_id: %1$s is not a block id. A block id looks like this: minecraft:stone
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.unknown_blo: There is no block called %1$s in this game.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.always_air: %1$s (%2$s) is always saved as air, no need to add it. So are air, water, lava and bubble columns.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.no_target: Your crosshair is not on a block (it must be within %1$s blocks). Look at the block and try again, or put the block id at the end of the command.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.save_failed: Could not save the list file, so the list did not change: %1$s
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.backup: The old list file that could not be read was kept as %1$s.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.no_permissi: You may not change the capture blacklist (it needs the same permission as /xjy).
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.file_proble: Note: the capture blacklist file could not be read (%1$s), so the list counts as empty. Fix it in a text editor and save; adding a block in the game also rewrites the file (the old one is kept as .bak). File: %2$s
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.problem.syn: something is wrong near line %1$s, column %2$s
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.skipped: %1$s entries in the list file are not block ids and were skipped, for example: %2$s
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.list_empty: The capture blacklist is empty. Add blocks with /xjy blacklist add <block>, or open the screen with /xjy blacklist.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.list_header: The capture blacklist has %1$s blocks; /xjy capture saves them as air:
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.list_more: …and %1$s more. Open the screen with /xjy blacklist to see them all.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.click_remov: Click to put the remove command into the chat box
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.gui.title: Capture Blacklist
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.gui.hint: Listed blocks are saved as air by /xjy capture. Water and lava are never saved; waterlogged blocks lose their water.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.gui.empty: The list is empty. Click a block in your inventory below, or type a block id at the bottom right, to add it.
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.gui.invento: Click a block to add it:
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.gui.remove_: Click to remove it from the list
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.gui.add_tip: Click to add it to the list
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.gui.not_blo: Not a block, cannot be added
xiaojingyu.command.blacklist.gui.problem: The list file could not be read, so the list counts as empty. See the chat for details.
xiaojingyu.command.error.out_of_height: The area goes outside the world height (%1$s to %2$s here).
xiaojingyu.command.error.not_loaded: Part of the area is not loaded. Move closer and try again.
xiaojingyu.command.error.busy: Your last build is not finished yet. Wait for it (see /xjy status).
xiaojingyu.command.place.bad_name: That is not the name of a file in the buildings folder: %1$s
xiaojingyu.command.place.not_found: There is no building called %1$s in %2$s.
xiaojingyu.command.place.too_many: That is too many blocks to place at once: %1$s (at most %2$s).
xiaojingyu.command.place.unknown_blocks: %1$s kinds of blocks in this file do not exist in this game, so nothing was placed. For example: %2$s
xiaojingyu.command.place.done: Placed %1$s blocks in %2$s s. Use /xjy undo to take it back.
xiaojingyu.command.place.warn_data_versi: Note: this file was made with a different game version (data version %1$s, this game: %2$s). Some blocks may look different.
xiaojingyu.command.place.warn_newer_form: Note: this file comes from a newer version of the mod. Some extra information is ignored.
xiaojingyu.command.job.stopped: Stopped: part of the area is no longer loaded. %1$s of %2$s blocks were done.
xiaojingyu.command.job.failed: Something went wrong; stopped after %1$s of %2$s blocks. See the game log.
xiaojingyu.command.undo.no_level: The dimension of that build is not available: %1$s
xiaojingyu.command.status.last_place: Last placed: %1$s, standing at %2$s, turned %3$s°, filling %4$s to %5$s (the area /xjy capture last reads).
xiaojingyu.command.status.no_place: No building placed in this world yet (/xjy capture last needs a /xjy place first).
xiaojingyu.command.status.capture_range: Plain /xjy capture takes %1$s in front, %2$s behind, %3$s to each side and %4$s up, the same as /xjy capture range %5$s. Change it in Mods → Xiao Jing Yu's Home → Config (single player) or in the server's config/xiaojingyu-common.toml.
xiaojingyu.command.share.unknown_file: This is neither a building picture (PNG) nor a .schem file.
xiaojingyu.command.share.bad_png: The picture file is incomplete, maybe it did not finish downloading. Save the original picture again and retry.
xiaojingyu.command.share.no_data: This picture has no block data. Chat apps (WeChat, QQ and so on) often compress pictures and strip extra data. Ask the sender to send the original image, or to send it as a file, and try again.
xiaojingyu.command.share.multiple_data: This picture has more than one copy of block data, so it is not clear which one to use.
xiaojingyu.command.share.bad_crc: The block data is damaged. Ask the sender for the original file again.
xiaojingyu.command.share.too_large: This building is too big, or has too much in it (at most 1024 blocks per side, 4,194,304 blocks in total).
xiaojingyu.command.share.bad_gzip: The block data is damaged (it could not be unpacked).
xiaojingyu.command.share.bad_nbt: The block data is damaged (its structure is wrong).
xiaojingyu.command.share.unsupported_ver: This file uses Sponge schematic version %1$s; only version 3 is supported.
xiaojingyu.command.photo.cleared: The frame is empty now (click again to start from the first photo)
xiaojingyu.command.photo.cleared_paintin: Back to the little painting (click again to start from the first photo)
xiaojingyu.command.photo.no_album: No photo album table within %1$s blocks; frames take their photos from the nearest one
xiaojingyu.command.photo.album_empty: The album is empty: add photos on the web page, then bring the house in
photo.xiaojingyu.album_missing: This world cannot find this album. Placement cancelled; your item is kept.
xiaojingyu.command.photo.album_count: The album has %1$s photos: right-click a frame nearby to change its photo, sneak to go back
